amendment_reason: The v1 diagnostic showed that a common absolute score threshold is not a comparable case-ranking statistic when the proposed QCCR/UMR stages alter score distributions. The v1 outputs remain retained as superseded diagnostics and are excluded from the paper figure.

display.class_color_policy: fixed color-blind-safe color per COCO category

paired_image_analysis.matching: class-aware greedy matching in descending prediction-score order
paired_image_analysis.metric: per-image 101-point interpolated AP pooled over annotated classes
paired_image_analysis.mean_metric: arithmetic mean of per-image AP at IoU 0.50:0.05:0.95

representative_selection.rule: six annotation-only medoids nearest fixed density-rank x overlap-rank targets
representative_selection.distance: squared Euclidean distance in empirical percentile-rank space

balanced_gain_selection.ranking: descending delta_image_AP75, then delta_image_mAP_50_95, then delta_image_AP50, then ascending image_id
balanced_gain_selection.honest_shortfall: use fewer than target_count when fewer eligible cases exist; never backfill with a trade-off case

failure_selection.rule: lowest delta_image_mAP_50_95, then delta_image_AP75, then delta_image_AP50, then ascending image_id

reporting_policy.purpose: post-hoc qualitative reporting and disclosed error analysis only
reporting_policy.v1_fixed_threshold_outputs: retained as superseded diagnostics; excluded from formal paper figures
